why_this_study_exists.the_mechanism_that_pre_refutes_entry_onl: 76.2% of the trades the deletion unlocks exit on ribbon_flip_back (vs 9.9% of the control book). The entry veto and the exit trigger read the SAME lagging Saty ribbon (EMA 13/20/48 stack on 5m closes), so a setup admitted against a non-stacked ribbon is round-tripped by that ribbon within minutes -- the block-set never gets a chance to be right or wrong. Any future entry-only 'loosen the ribbon' will null this same way (recorded in filter5-ribbon-2026-07-31.md as the by-product finding).
why_this_study_exists.the_untested_change: The PAIRED arm: for LEVEL-ANCHORED setups only, (a) filter 5 does not veto the entry AND (b) ribbon_flip_back is not their exit. They keep every other exit: structure_stop (v15.3 chart-stop-primary -- the level thesis owns the invalidation), -50% catastrophe cap, TP1 +100%/66.7%, chandelier trail 15% off HWM post-TP1, runner_target, 15:40 time stop. This paired arm has NEVER been measured (confirmed by the 07-31 study's own closing note).
why_this_study_exists.adjacent_prior_art_not_this_study: G2-TRENDLINE-BYPASS-INVERTS-PRIORITY (decided 2026-08-01, commit dbd35729, neither arm shipped): tested extending the BEAR trendline-only bypass (filters 5+8+9 with score demerits, filters.py trendline_bypass_scope='all_level_tied') to all level-tied bear setups -- ENTRY-ONLY, bear-only, and bundled VIX filter 8 + filter 9 relief. Different mechanism from this study (both directions, filter 5 only, no demerit, PAIRED with exit suppression). Cited so nobody mistakes this for a retest of that null; its entry-only shape is exactly what the 76.2% mechanism above pre-refutes.

hypothesis: H1: for level-anchored setups, the level thesis (chart structure stop + catastrophe cap + profit ladder) is the honest invalidation and the lagging ribbon is noise on BOTH sides of the trade. Removing the ribbon from both the entry gate AND the exit path for this cohort -- as ONE paired change -- yields a positive book delta over the PRIMARY recent-25-trading-day window, without regressing the sacred runner cohort.

cohort_definition.level_anchored: a setup whose triggers_fired contains >=1 STATIC-level-tied trigger. Bull: {level_reclaim, confluence, sequence_reclaim} (filters.py:1265's own level_tied set). Bear: {level_rejection, fhh_level_rejection, confluence, sequence_rejection} (filters.py:1723's set MINUS trendline_rejection).
cohort_definition.why_fhh_included: fhh_level_rejection is a STATIC intraday level (first-hour high), fires only when base levels produced no rejection, and populates rejection_level so the chart structure-stop works (filters.py:1602-1609, L96). ARM_B's 07-31 frozen set predates consideration of fhh; including it is the faithful 'static level' semantics. Disclosed as the one delta from ARM_B's cohort definition.
cohort_definition.why_trendline_excluded: trendline_rejection is a dynamic line, its cohort is the established LOSING book (trendline-only -$1,830/124tr vs level-tied +$6,895/66tr, PNL-ATTRIBUTION-2026-07-28), and the bear trendline-only shape ALREADY bypasses filter 5 in production (2026-05-09 precedent, filters.py:1619-1630) -- there is nothing left to relax for it at entry, and extending exit relief to a losing cohort is not this hypothesis.

EXIT: every trade in the PAIRED book whose triggers_fired is level-anchored (definition above) is walked with ribbon_flip_back structurally suppressed (walk_exit_manager ribbon_tick_df=None -- plan_exit_actions consumes the flag at exactly its 2 exit-trigger sites, automation/state/fleet/exit_manager.py:430+483, nothing else reads it); every non-level-anchored trade keeps the standard walk. All other exit stages unchanged.
arms_frozen.entry_mechanism_note: disable_filters=[5] is used as the entry mechanism because ARM_B (the properly scoped filter5_level_anchored_bypass flag, run 2026-07-31 before being reverted per C14) measured BYTE-IDENTICAL to deletion on this exact population -- structural reason recorded in filter5_ribbon_fate_2026_07_31.py: a bull setup blocked by filter 5 alone cannot carry ribbon_flip (detect_ribbon_flip_bullish requires stack==BULL), so it met min_triggers=2 via static-level triggers BY CONSTRUCTION; bear trendline-only already bypasses 5. HARD INVARIANT (run aborts if violated): every entry ADDED by PAIRED vs CONTROL must satisfy the level_anchored predicate. If any added entry is not level-anchored, the deletion-equals-scoped-bypass equivalence has broken on this population and the study STOPS rather than silently measuring a different cohort.
arms_frozen.no_variant_grid: Exactly ONE treatment arm. No sweeps, no thresholds, no tuning knobs. m=1, so BH-FDR reduces to the single advisory p-value at alpha=0.10. If the paired change needs a tuned variant to clear its gates, it fails.

changed_trade_semantics.why_extended: unlike the 07-31 study, this change touches EXITS of trades common to both books, so the 07-31 added/dropped-only diff would be blind to exit-side deltas (C7 shape). Trade identity stays (date, entry_time_et, symbol, side).
changed_trade_semantics.contribution_of_a_change: added trade: +arm_pnl. dropped trade: -ctrl_pnl. common trade with pnl delta: (arm_pnl - ctrl_pnl).
changed_trade_semantics.changed_day: any day carrying an added trade, a dropped trade, OR a common trade whose dollar_pnl differs from CONTROL's.
changed_trade_semantics.delta_identity_check: window delta_total MUST equal sum(added) - sum(dropped ctrl pnl) + sum(common deltas); asserted at runtime.

ship_rule: SHIP only if G1 AND G2 AND G3 AND G4 AND G5 all pass. Target: ONE fleet arm as a forward-paper TRIAL -- FLEET-LOOSE-R (display risky-3), the free loose-gate arm (bold-2 carries the block_elite_bull-lift trial, risky-1 carries the full-send experiment, safe-3 stays clean control). Wiring (built ONLY on a pass, never speculatively): re-add the filters.py scoped-bypass flag exactly as reverted + a per-entry exit-side ribbon-suppression flag threaded to that arm only, each with a RED-proofed guard test. KILL CRITERION (pre-registered): auto-revert if the arm's level-anchored cohort reaches (a) n>=10 fills with cumulative cohort P&L < $0, OR (b) 5 consecutive cohort losers, OR (c) any single day cohort P&L <= -$120 (2 catastrophe-cap losses at min size); the standing nightly gate-expiry/revalidation clock applies on top. If ANY gate fails: NULL -- filter 5 STAYS, ribbon_flip_back STAYS, and the ribbon question is declared CLOSED BOTH WAYS (entry-only null 2026-07-31, paired null 2026-08-01) in the graveyard with the numbers; no further ribbon-loosening variants without genuinely new information (a regime break in the population or a structural change to the exit stack).
reporting_rule: ALL cells reported -- both arms, both windows, added/dropped/changed-common cohorts each with n/total/WR/per-trade/ex-best, fire counts for BOTH levers, OPRA measurability stratified by window, attribution decomposition (added vs pre-empted vs exit-delta) via filter5_ribbon_fate.attribution_block PLUS the common-trade exit-delta extension. Synthetic P&L is disclosed AND excluded (there is none: real-OPRA-only).
